---
name: Standard proposal
about: Propose a change to the canonical format, profile, or schema
title: '[standard] '
labels: proposal
---

## Problem

What portability or safety problem does this solve?

## Proposed canonical behavior

Describe the format and normative behavior. Include an example when useful.

## Compatibility and migration

State whether this is compatible, which version change it requires, and how
existing repositories and adapters will migrate.

## Security considerations

Describe secret handling, command execution, file-system behavior, and other
relevant risks.

## Conformance evidence

List the schemas, valid/invalid fixtures, adapter capability changes, and
tests required before this can be accepted.
